# FutureCount

FutureCount Holdings LLC is led by Eric Bass, a CFO and adviser with more than 30 years in financial services. It helps owners and CEOs strengthen their companies and prepare for an ownership transition or a sale to a strategic buyer, through a Deep-Dive & Direction with implementation support, or sale readiness and transaction support through closing.

## Pages
- [Home](https://futurecountllc.com/): Two ways FutureCount helps, preparing for a sale and selected engagements.
- [How I work](https://futurecountllc.com/diagnostic.html): Deep-Dive & Direction and implementation, or sale readiness and transaction support.
- [Financial services](https://futurecountllc.com/financial-services.html): CFO and transaction advisory for broker-dealers, fintechs and the firms that serve them.
- [Insights](https://futurecountllc.com/insights/): Practical perspectives on earnings quality, sale readiness and ownership transitions.
- [Quality of earnings for fintech CEOs](https://futurecountllc.com/insights/quality-of-earnings.html): Public fintech examples, source citations and company-side preparation for a sale.
- [About Eric](https://futurecountllc.com/about.html): Selected experience and public sources.
- [Talk with Eric](https://futurecountllc.com/contact.html): A 30-minute introductory conversation; separate from a scoped Deep-Dive & Direction engagement.

Website information is general and does not replace professional tax, legal or investment advice.
